name: Enkon
biography: Pongo iracundis. A blazing ape elemental whose flames burn hotter the angrier it gets — every heavy blow stokes its rage and upgrades its fire dice, and even death struggles to stick. Habitat: Jungle.

features.name: Blazing Rage
features.description: Whenever the enkon takes 20+ damage in a single instance, its rage level increases by one, up to a maximum of level 5. The die size of the enkon's Fire damage increases with its rage level: d4s at level 1, d6s at level 2, d8s at level 3, d10s at level 4, and d12s at level 5. The enkon's rage decreases by one level, to a minimum of level 1, if the Calm Emotions spell is cast on it or when it goes 24 hours without taking damage.

features.name: Endless Fury
features.description: If damage reduces the enkon to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is from a Critical Hit. The enkon adds its rage level to the total of its roll. On a successful save, the enkon drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

features.name: Flame Body
features.description: A creature that touches the enkon or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (1d4) Fire damage (see Blazing Rage trait).

features.name: Illumination
features.description: The enkon sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The enkon makes two attacks, using Flaming Fist or Fiery Fling in any combination.

features.name: Flaming Fist
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Fire damage (see Blazing Rage trait).

features.name: Fiery Fling
features.description: The enkon ignites a piece of debris and throws it. Ranged Weapon Attack: +8, range 40/120 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Fire damage (see Blazing Rage trait).
